rows.en:
(Swimming's next. That's a relief,
with how hot it is today.)
Hm? Is that Alto?
Kyaaa~!
rows.notes: x2, Female Student A, both genders; fans squealing at Alto.

rows.en: Man...
Kyaaa~!!
rows.notes: x2, Female Student B, both genders.

rows.en: he's really something...
rows.notes: Male; ends the thought begun in c15712 ('Man... he's really something...').

rows.en:
Hm? \p?
What's with that face?
Nah, I was just thinking you're really something...

What? You're making a big deal out of
a little swimming. Geez.

(Uh...
I meant Alto's popularity, not the swimming.)

(Swimming's next, right? That's a relief,
with how hot it is today.)
Hm? Is that Saotome-kun?
amazing...
rows.notes: Female; follows c03826 'It's kinda...' between the squeals, so it continues that sentence.

rows.en: Oh, I was just thinking you're really something...

(Hmm...
I meant Saotome-kun's popularity,
not the swimming.)
(Okay, I need to get ready for next class...)

Ugh, looks like I forgot the media with
the lecture data for next class...

Hm? \p.
What's wrong?
Well, actually, the lecture data for class...
rows.notes: Male; trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en: What, that's all? Then use this.
Huh? What about you, Alto?

That boring class? Not hearing it
won't make any difference, right?
Wow~, spoken like the eternal runner-up...
rows.notes: Male; 'mannen ni-i' = always in second place (Alto ranks second in the Pilot Course).

rows.en: Ugh, you...! Give that back!
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; 'yappari sore kaese' (changed his mind).

rows.en: Ah, kidding, kidding, my bad...

(I think second place is still pretty amazing,
though...)
(Okay, I need to get ready for next class...)

Oh no, looks like I forgot the media with
the lecture data for next class...
Yeah, actually, the lecture data for class...
Huh? What about you, Saotome-kun?
Hmm~, spoken like the eternal runner-up...
Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't mean anything by it...
(Lunch break at last... What should I eat...)
Huh, it's Alto. I wonder what he's eating?
rows.notes: Male; no brackets in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Oh, I was just wondering what you're eating...
Wait, is that a homemade lunch?!
Yeah, it is. So what?
Must be nice to be so popular with girls...
rows.notes: Male; assumes a girl made the lunch.

rows.en: Aren't you getting the wrong idea?
Huh? About what?
I made this myself, you know...
Huh, really?
rows.notes: x3: male player (nml_alt_014), female player (nml_mcl), Hoshimura (Valentine); generic.

rows.en:
Yeah. Not every day, but sometimes
I just feel like making one.
Huh, leave it to the genius of female roles.
rows.notes: Male; 'tensai onnagata', as the book title in c03783 ('A Genius in Female Roles').

rows.en: That's got nothing to do with it!
(Alto's surprisingly good with his hands...)

(Phew, lunch break at last...
What should I eat...)

Huh, it's Saotome-kun. I wonder what
he's eating?

Oh, I was just wondering what you're eating...
Wait, could that be a homemade lunch?!
Must be nice to be so popular with girls~...
Huh? About what?
Huh, really?!
Hmm~, leave it to the genius of female roles~

(Saotome-kun's surprisingly good with
his hands...)

(Okay, classes are over.
Guess I'll head home.)

\p.
You heading home now too?

Yeah, you too, Alto?
Then want to head home together?
Ah, sorry, I'll pass today.
Huh? You got something to do?

Well, something like that.
There's somewhere I want to stop by...
If it won't take long, I can tag along.

Nah, it's not the kind of thing
I need company for.
I see. Next time, then.
(Alto seems kind of lonely sometimes...)

(Okay, classes are over.
Time to head home.)

Oh, you too, Saotome-kun?
Then want to head home together?
Huh? Do you have something to do?
I see... Next time, then.
(Saotome-kun seems kind of lonely sometimes...)

uncertain: c15712/c15714: 'shikashi...' and 'sasuga da na...' are cut by the fans' squeals; English runs them as one thought ('Man...' / 'he's really something...').
c15721: 'sugoi wa ne...' follows the shared row c03826 'It's kinda...' (already translated), so it is lowercase 'amazing...' to finish that sentence.
c15731/c15739: 'mannen ni-i' rendered 'the eternal runner-up' (Alto always second in the Pilot Course); c15734 keeps 'second place'.
c15745/c15757: 'sasuga moteru otoko wa chigau na' rendered 'Must be nice to be so popular with girls' to carry the implied 'a girl made it for you', which Alto then corrects.
